questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question validates practical knowledge of AWS Change Manager for SAP workloads, emphasizing cross-account trust relationships, automated configuration deployment, and compliance-ready auditing.

## Key Concepts
- **AWS Systems Manager Change Manager**: Enterprise change management platform for approving and applying configuration changes
- **Cross-account IAM roles**: Enable centralized governance without permanent credentials in target accounts
- **SSM State Manager associations**: Automate script execution (such as SAP startup scripts) on managed instances
- **CloudTrail**: Provides immutable audit logs of all API actions for compliance and troubleshooting

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  SAPChangeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SAP-ChangeManager-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::CENTRAL_ACCOUNT_ID:root
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSM-SendCommand-Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                Resource: arn:aws:ec2:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:instance/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ssm:ResourceTag/Environment: SAP

  SSMAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSMAssociation
    Properties:
      AssociationName: SAP-Startup-Script
      DocumentName: AWS-RunShellScript
      Targets:
        - Key: tag:Environment
          Values:
            - SAP
      Parameters:
        commands:
          - /opt/sap/startup.sh
```

## CloudTrail Configuration
```yaml
CloudTrail:
  Type: AWS::CloudTrail
  Properties:
    IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
    IsMultiRegionTrail: true
    S3BucketName: central-audit-bucket
    IsOrganizationTrail: true
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- Immutable cross-region backups (S3 Object Lock, Compliance mode)
- SAP HANA log shipping and restore validation
- Cross-account CMK management and IAM trust boundaries

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  SAPBackupBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: sap-backups-prod
      ObjectLockConfiguration:
        ObjectLockEnabled: Enabled
        Rule:
          DefaultRetention:
```

## Why This Is Asked

- Tagging enforcement across accounts
- Service Control Policies (SCPs)
- CloudWatch alarms and Lambda remediation
- Cross-account deployment considerations

## Code Example
```yaml
# CloudFormation-like snippet for a guard alarm
Resources:
  SAPIdleCPUAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref SAPInstanceId
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 86400
      EvaluationPeriods: 7
      Threshold: 5
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !GetAtt RemediationLambda.Arn
```

## Why This Is Asked

- SAP HANA AMI on EC2 deployment
- CloudWatch Events and Lambda for lifecycle automation
- Centralized logging to S3
- Lightweight CloudFormation templating

## Code Example

```yaml
Resources:
  SandboxIAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SandboxAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                Resource: '*'
  LambdaExpiryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents

```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to architect serverless SAP batch orchestration, cross-account security, idempotency, and auditability.

## Key Concepts
- Step Functions, Lambda
- SAP RFC batch submission, ABAP jobs
- Idempotency, retries, compensation
- STS cross-account credentials
- Centralized auditing

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPBatchLauncherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPBatchExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: arn:aws:iam::*:role/SAPOperatorRole
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  SAPBatchStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      DefinitionString:
        !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "SAP Batch Job Orchestration",
          "StartAt": "ValidateInput",
          "States": {
            "ValidateInput": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:validate-batch-input",
              "Next": "CheckIdempotency",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.Unknown", "Lambda.ServiceException"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                "MaxAttempts": 3,
                "BackoffRate": 2.0
              }]
            },
            "CheckIdempotency": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:check-dedupe",
              "Next": "SubmitABAPJob",
              "Catch": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["DuplicateJob"],
                "Next": "SkipExecution"
              }]
            },
            "SubmitABAPJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:submit-abap-batch",
              "Next": "MonitorJob",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["SAPConnectionError", "RFCError"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                "MaxAttempts": 5,
                "BackoffRate": 2.0
              }, {
                "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 10,
                "MaxAttempts": 2,
                "BackoffRate": 1.5
              }],
              "Catch": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                "Next": "CancelJob",
                "ResultPath": "$.error"
              }]
            },
            "MonitorJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:monitor-abap-status",
              "Next": "LogCompletion",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["JobInProgress"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 30,
                "MaxAttempts": 20,
                "BackoffRate": 1.2
              }]
            },
            "CancelJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:cancel-abap-batch",
              "Next": "LogFailure",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["CancelError"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                "MaxAttempts": 3,
                "BackoffRate": 1.5
              }]
            },
            "LogCompletion": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-log",
              "End": true
            },
            "LogFailure": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-log",
              "End": true
            },
            "SkipExecution": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-duplicate",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SAPBatchLauncherRole.Arn
```

- IAM roles with least-privilege principles

- DR testing to validate RPO/RTO targets

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cross-account KMS key for SAP backups
Resources:
  SAPBackupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SAP backup encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: sap-backup-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow AWS Backup Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalAccount:
                  - !Ref ProdAccountId
                  - !Ref DRAccountId
  BackupVaultPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: sap-primary-vault
      BackupVaultPolicy:
        Version: '2010-09-09'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Allow Cross Account Backup
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${ProdAccountId}:role/BackupServiceRole
            Action:
              - backup:PutBackupVaultAccessPolicy
              - backup:ListBackupVaults
              - backup:DescribeBackupVault
            Resource: !GetAtt SAPBackupKey.Arn
```
